title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Maha warns against Anbu's second marriage with Vennila. Meanwhile, Kanmani hides her pregnancy, rejects Anbu's advice on health, and is later shocked to see him at the hospital.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman brings Kumaresan and Ganthimathi to Kalamma's house after learning they have been driven out. Despite Kalamma's refusal, he insists they stay.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Divya questions Karna about his attack on Vetri before his court testimony, growing suspicious of him. Shanmugam worries after vacating his tailoring shop and hopes for a new job.
